jobs.description:
Job Description

Fugro USA Land, Inc., seeks Senior Geologist. Worksite 201 N Civic Drive #360, Walnut Creek, CA 94596 (Partial telecommuting – 2 days per week). Offered salary $123,240 per year. (REQ # R0031542
) on resume.

Duties And Responsibilities

Under the direction of the Principal Geologist, demonstrate proficient report/proposal writing and verbal communication skills. Work on geologic hazard assessment and site characterization for various infrastructure projects, especially fault studies, seismic hazard assessments, seismic source modeling and catalog development, field mapping, geologic interpretation of geotechnical and geospatial data, and geologic hazard assessments. Conduct fieldwork including rock, soil sampling, geologic mapping and site assessment; assist in analyzing geologic data, interpreting findings and prepare reports; support drilling operations including core logging and sample preparation; utilize geologic software to interpret and present data; ensure compliance with environmental and safety regulations; collaborate with other geologists and engineers to support project developments; maintain accurate records of geologic and geotechnical observations, test results, and site conditions, assist in laboratory testing and analysis; work on desktop studies; and support proposal preparation. Mentor junior staff. Work on business/client development, with lead role on proposal presentation. Manage all aspects of multiple small to mid-size projects/year (budget, schedule, scope of work, client relations). Support technical needs of clients. Involvement and participation in the design, implementation, and supervision of field exploration programs, and detailed site characterization studies. Participate in the development of the scope, estimating costs, and procuring subcontractors. Develop and adhere to reasonable project schedules and deadlines. Research and data analysis. Perform engineering geologic analyses and develop reasonable conclusions and recommendations. Develop seismic source models and earthquake catalogs. Prepare technical reports in a timely, organized, and accurate manner. Develop positive client relationships. Maintain positive reputation in professional community. Contribute to positive corporate reputation. Help develop project opportunities. Participate in and support continuous improvement of the company's processes, including safety and quality. Perform other duties as may be assigned.

Required Education And Experience

Master's degree in Engineering Geology, or Geological Engineering.
2 years of field experience in soil and rock logging, geologic mapping, site characterization, and paleoseismological trenching for fault investigations; experience with geologic and geotechnical data interpretation, integration of downhole geophysical data, and development of geologic models to support engineering decisions; experience preparing technical reports and desktop studies, managing projects—including those in the nuclear power projects—and performing rock mass characterization; synthesize complex geological data to assess site conditions and support multidisciplinary project teams.
Special Requirement
Any understanding of geohazards and their implications for project planning and development.
Partial telecommuting – 2 days per week
25% of domestic travel.

Tactica Solutions is seeking an experienced Geospatial Analyst Expert to support the U.S. Army INSCOM APOGEE program at Fort Gordon. This is a high-impact opportunity to apply advanced geospatial analysis and GIS expertise in direct support of critical Army and national intelligence requirements.

In this role, you will bring deep knowledge of the full spectrum of government and commercial GEOINT capabilities, spatial data processing, analytic modeling, and industry-standard tools such as Esri ArcGIS, QGIS, MapBox, and GeoServer to solve complex geospatial intelligence challenges. You will work side-by-side with partners across the Intelligence Community and Department of Defense, producing clear, actionable geospatial intelligence through well-crafted reports, graphics, briefings, and multimedia presentations that senior leaders rely on.

At Tactica, we value sharp analysts who take ownership of their work and contribute to a collaborative, mission-focused team. If you are ready to put your geospatial expertise to work on a program that matters, we want to talk with you.

Why this role stands out

Direct support to INSCOM’s GEOINT mission
Onsite work at Fort Gordon with a dedicated team
Opportunity to apply advanced GIS, spatial modeling, and geospatial data expertise to real operational decisions

Responsibilities

The Geospatial Analyst shall perform analysis of the full spectrum of US Government and commercial GEOINT assets and maintain expertise in all associated tradecraft, including Synthetic Aperture RADAR (SAR), Electro-Optical (EO), Moving Target Indicator (MTI), Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR), Overhead Persistent Infrared (OPIR), Geospatial Information and Services (GI&S), Wide Area Persistent Surveillance (WAPS), geospatial data processing, analysis and modeling, and general intelligence analysis.
Maintain proficiency with all tools and databases necessary to access supporting intelligence information required for the execution of GEOINT support to the customer.

Remain abreast of geo-political events, topics, atmospherics, and current events as they relate to supported Combatant Commands and respective theaters, to provide informed, insightful, and timely answers to customer intelligence requirements.

Extensive experience with geographically-derived assessments, enterprise data integration, spatial data governance, metadata management and interpretation of business and performance metrics.
Demonstrated experience using geospatial Python, R, SAS, Java or other coding languages to deliver custom geoprocessing and analytical workflows.

Experience working within common project management frameworks.

to support the NOAA Office of Habitat Conservation’s NOAA Chesapeake Bay Office (NCBO) in Annapolis, MD. Data collection, standardization and processing: provide ingest, standardization, and processing for CBIBS, hypoxia, and other observational data to ensure quality and readiness for product integration.
Data Product Development: develop data and information products utilizing CBIBS, hypoxia and other observational data in support of NCBOs habitat and fisheries constituents.
Data visualization and interpretation: design intuitive visualizations and interpretive materials to effectively communicate data product insights to NCBO's habitat and fisheries constituents.

Overview

To be part of our organization, every employee should understand and share in the YNHHS Vision, support our Mission, and live our Values. These values - integrity, patient-centered, respect, accountability, and compassion - must guide what we do, as individuals and professionals, every day.

The Infection Prevention Support Analyst applies analytical, epidemiologic, and informatics methods to clinical, operational, and surveillance data to support infection prevention, patient safety, quality outcomes, and regulatory compliance across the Yale New Haven Health System. Working under the direction of Infection Prevention leadership, this role independently evaluates complex healthcare

data, identifies infection prevention risks and emerging trends, develops meaningful analyses and reports, and translates findings into actionable recommendations that support strategic decision -making and performance improvement initiatives.

The Infection Prevention Support Analyst serves as a key resource for healthcare -associated infection (HAI) surveillance, regulatory reporting, predictive analytics, dashboard development, outbreak investigation support, and system-wide infection prevention initiatives. The role collaborates closely with Infection Preventionists, clinical leaders, quality teams, operational leadership, information systems, and external agencies to drive data -informed decision making and improve patient outcomes.

EEO/AA/Disability/Veteran

Applies analytical and epidemiologic methods to evaluate infection prevention, quality, safety, and operational data across multiple healthcare settings.
Independently analyzes complex clinical, laboratory, surveillance, utilization, and operational datasets to identify infection prevention risks, trends, variation in practice, and opportunities for intervention.
Develops, maintains, and enhances dashboards, reports, scorecards, data visualizations, and other analytic tools to support Infection Prevention leadership and organizational priorities.
Performs healthcare-associated infection surveillance activities, including data validation, case review, NHSN reporting, denominator analysis, and outcome measurement.
Interprets and analyzes surveillance findings and develops meaningful summaries, recommendations, and presentations for infection prevention, clinical, operational, and executive leadership.
Utilizes electronic health records, data warehouses, surveillance systems, artificial intelligence applications, and business intelligence tools to retrieve, manage, analyze, and present data.

Conducts statistical analyses and trend evaluations to support performance improvement initiatives, strategic planning, regulatory readiness, and program evaluation.
Identifies emerging infection prevention risks, epidemiologically significant organisms, and unusual patterns requiring further investigation or intervention.
Collaborates with Infection Preventionists and operational leaders in outbreak, cluster, and exposure investigations through advanced data analysis, case finding, trend identification, and reporting.
Supports development and evaluation of evidence-based infection prevention interventions through outcome measurement, process monitoring and effectiveness assessments.
Provides consultation and analytic support to clinical, quality, patient safety, nursing, physician, and operational teams regarding infection prevention performance indicators and outcome measures.
Assists in the development of predictive analytics, risk stratification methodologies, and innovative approaches to infection prevention surveillance and performance monitoring.
Ensures data governance standards, data integrity, and consistency across multiple reporting platforms and information systems.
Participates in system-wide quality improvement initiatives and utilizes YNHHS performance improvement methodologies to support organizational goals.
Maintains current knowledge of epidemiology, infection prevention practices, healthcare analytics, statistical methodologies, data visualization technologies, regulatory requirements, and emerging industry trends.
Performs other related job duties as requested or required.

Qualifications

EDUCATION

Associates degree as a Licensed Practical Nurse or Bachelors degree in Public Health, Epidemiology, Nursing, Health Informatics, Data Analytics, Biostatistics, Microbiology, Healthcare Administration, or a related field required. Masters degree in Public Health (MPH), Epidemiology, Health Informatics, Data Science, Biostatistics, Nursing, or related field preferred.

Experience

Minimum of two (2) years of healthcare or related experience preferred. Experience in infection prevention, quality, patient safety, or epidemiology preferred.

Special Skills

Demonstrated ability to independently analyze, interpret, and communicate complex healthcare data from multiple sources.
Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify meaningful trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, scorecards, and data visualizations for clinical, operational, and executive audiences.
Knowledge of epidemiologic principles, healthcare-associated infection surveillance methodologies, quality improvement processes, and regulatory reporting requirements.
Proficiency with electronic health record reporting tools, healthcare analytics platforms, data visualization software, and Microsoft Office applications. Experience with infection prevention surveillance systems, statistical software, artificial intelligence applications , business intelligence tools, and large healthcare datasets preferred.
Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate technical findings and recommendations to diverse clinical and operational stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and exercise sound professional judgment in a complex healthcare environment.

Accountability

Requires self motivation and independent work in developing analysis and independently making recommendations on analysis results.
In personal and job-related decisions and actions, consistently demonstrates the values of integrity (doing the right thing), patient-centered (putting patients and families first), respect (valuing all people and embracing all differences), accountability (being responsible and taking action), and compassion (being empathetic).

Complexity

The position will require responding to public health emergencies with rapid turnaround times for communication, initiation and completion of assignments. This position will require prioritization, prompt action, and attention to detail in documentation and data management as multiple investigations will be conducted simultaneously.

Additional Information

PHYSICAL DEMAND

The position will require daily use of a computer, telephone/cell phone, and access to a secure internet connection. Involves viewing a computer screen approx. 50-80 percent of the time. The position requires both onsite and telework activities, while complying with all requirements for client confidentiality, records, and data security.

jobs.description:
About Code Metal

Code Metal is redefining code translation for mission-critical industries, helping defense partners move more quickly and reliably from algorithm to silicon. Our platform accelerates deployment of DSP, RF, communications, and embedded signal processing algorithms onto heterogeneous compute targets, including GPUs, FPGAs, ASICs, and edge SoCs. We also support automotive, aerospace, and semiconductor partners deploying complex algorithms onto constrained hardware with speed and rigor.

Solutions Engineer

Code Metal is looking for a Solutions Engineer to sit at the intersection of engineering, prototyping, and customer growth - turning promising opportunities into working technical systems. You'll be a hands-on bridge between our platform and real-world use, building and validating customer solutions through proofs of concept and early development, then helping transition successful work toward repeatable production use.

Who thrives in this role:

Engineers who enjoy turning loosely defined customer problems into working systems.
Technically curious people who can quickly explore unfamiliar domains, prototype approaches, and turn what they learn into working solutions.
Hands-on builders who combine strong technical judgment with rapid execution and follow-through.
Comfortable owning the technical execution of a customer problem - from a scoped opportunity through a validated proof of concept and early deployment.
Thrive in open-ended environments and can context-switch quickly across technical domains.
Willing to learn quickly and go deep when a customer problem demands it.
A strong technical background is required, whether your experience comes from engineering, research, or other technical roles. You'll often be among the first engineers to prove how Code Metal's technology can solve a new customer problem in practice.

Responsibilities:

Turn scoped customer opportunities into working technical solutions that demonstrate how Code Metal's technology can be applied in real-world systems.
Work with customer engineers and stakeholders to understand development needs, system constraints, and success criteria, then translate them into executable implementation plans.
Rapidly investigate unfamiliar technical domains and de-risk solution paths through hands-on prototyping, integration, and feasibility testing.
Build and lead proofs of concept (PoCs), working with Solutions Architects, product, engineering, and customer teams to turn an agreed approach into a validated system.
Implement complex algorithms and compute-heavy pipelines (DSP, RF, communications, and similar workloads) on GPUs, FPGAs, and edge systems using Code Metal's platform.
Profile, debug, and tune PoCs and early deployments for latency, throughput, memory, and power across heterogeneous compute environments.
Debug across heterogeneous systems (CPU/GPU/FPGA), identifying and resolving issues spanning algorithms, software, hardware, and toolchains.
Use PoCs and technical demos to make Code Metal's product differentiators concrete and measurable for customers.
Capture reusable code, integration patterns, and playbooks from successful PoCs so future customer work can move faster.
Support early integration and validation as needed, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineers when work transitions into sustained deployment or production.
Work across Solutions Architecture, Forward Deployed Engineering, product, core engineering, research, and growth, feeding technical learnings back into the platform and customer strategy.

Requirements:

Strong background in computer science, systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, or a related technical field.
Ability to quickly learn unfamiliar domains and turn new technical information into practical experiments and implementations.
Strong analytical thinking, problem decomposition, and hands-on prototyping skills.
Demonstrated ability to debug complex systems across software and hardware boundaries.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain implementation tradeoffs and technical results clearly to customers and internal teams.
Self-starter who can operate independently and effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
Willingness to travel occasionally to customer sites as needed (est. 10%-20% travel)

Great to Have:

Experience designing or architecting complex technical systems.
Broad cross-domain software experience in one or more of: C/C++, Rust, Python, Verilog/VHDL, MATLAB, CUDA/OpenCL.
Hands-on experience with GPU programming, FPGA development, embedded or edge systems, especially where software, hardware, and physical systems intersect.
Experience with compute-intensive workloads such as DSP, RF, communications, or computer vision.
Experience working with U.S. Government programs or dual-use technologies.
Active U.S. security clearance (Secret or Top Secret), or eligibility to obtain one.

Level Expectations by Track

This role is open at Senior, Staff, or Principal level. The expectations below describe how scope, ownership, and technical leadership differ by level; candidates are evaluated against the level they are hired into.

Senior:

Years of Experience: 5+
Engineering Craft & Code Quality: Writes clean, idiomatic, well-tested code/output and follows best practices; drives debugging of the team's hardest issues; ensures AI-assisted work is correct, modular, and fully tested.
Architecture & Technical Knowledge: Designs and implements changes to single systems, collaborates on larger designs, and drives architecture reviews for multi-developer projects.
Delivery, Scoping & De-risking: Works with Product to scope and de-risk work; provides reliable estimates for medium-sized projects with clear risk communication.

The Public Health Institute (PHI) is an independent, nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting health, well-being, and quality of life for people throughout California, across the nation and around the world. PHI was distinguished as one of the top 50 “Best Non-Profit Organizations to Work For” by the Non-Profit Times in a national search.

Position Summary

The original FACES for the Future Health Scholars program was established in 2000 at Children’s Hospital of Oakland; in 2011 FACES programs moved under the fiscal sponsorship of Public Health Institute, which allowed the creation of FACES for the Future Coalition (www.facesforthefuture.org). The Coalition, now national, both runs its own programs in California and New Mexico and supports affiliate members in San Diego and Colorado. Innovative and health careers focused, there are three main FACES programs: Health Scholars, Public Health Youth Corps, and the Summer Medical Academy. All FACES programs serve public high school students interested in public, medical, behavioral and global health careers. The Coalition’s work also includes new program and curriculum development, technical assistance consulting, evaluation, marketing and communications, and fund development.

The FACES for the Future Coalition is looking for a Program Coordinator for the FACES program in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The FACES program will be working with students and teachers to create work-based learning experiences to build capacity at partner school sites. This person will be primarily responsible for the planning, coordination, and supervision of daily operations. This includes host advisory committee meetings, implementation and supervision of clinical internship placements and rotations, academic support and mentoring, and coordination of the wellness program for students. The Program Coordinator is responsible for ensuring that all students meet the program expectations regarding training, performance, rules and behavior. The Program Coordinator will work to guarantee that program materials are current and relevant, that operations run in a smooth and effective manner, and that open and regular communication exists with all program partners and stakeholders including health care professionals, health agency administration, school administration, teachers, students and families.

This is a time-limited, part-time (50% FTE) position that is expected to have a work schedule of 20 hours/week and end on May 28, 2027, with a possibility to extend based on funding availability.

Code Metal is redefining code translation for mission-critical industries, helping defense partners move more quickly and reliably from algorithm to silicon. Solutions Engineer

Code Metal is looking for a Solutions Engineer to sit at the intersection of engineering, prototyping, and customer growth - turning promising opportunities into working technical systems. You'll be a hands-on bridge between our platform and real-world use, building and validating customer solutions through proofs of concept and early development, then helping transition successful work toward repeatable production use.

Engineers who enjoy turning loosely defined customer problems into working systems.
Technically curious people who can quickly explore unfamiliar domains, prototype approaches, and turn what they learn into working solutions.
Hands-on builders who combine strong technical judgment with rapid execution and follow-through.
Comfortable owning the technical execution of a customer problem - from a scoped opportunity through a validated proof of concept and early deployment.

Strong background in computer science, systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, or a related technical field.

Job Category: Project and Program Management

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly experienced and skilled Project Coordinator to join our elite team in Sterling, VA. In this role, you will be instrumental in supporting our mission-critical projects in the field of counter-manned systems (C-UxS) under a large Department of Defense (DoD) contract. This position demands a professional with extensive project management experience, in-depth knowledge of related duties, and the ability to drive project success through meticulous planning and execution. If you are a seasoned project coordinator with a proven track record, we invite you to apply.

Responsibilities

Provide advanced project operations support, including comprehensive updates to CACI and customer program documentation, detailed reporting, and rigorous tracking of cost, schedule, and performance program parameters.
Coordinate and facilitate high-stakes meetings, ensuring precise agendas, thorough documentation of action items, and professional compilation of meeting minutes for distribution.
Create and consolidate complex inputs to deliver superior program/project deliverables, reporting intricate trends, anticipated issues, and sophisticated programmatic risks to senior management and teammates.
Facilitate the completion and tracking of intricate requirements for personnel traveling TDY (Temporary Duty) or PCS (Permanent Change of Station) to OCONUS locations, including intricate visa, work/residency permit, and housing arrangements.
Coordinate and track sophisticated short-term travel of team members to CONUS and OCONUS locations, managing detailed travel authorization requests, securing customer approvals, sending precise Visit Requests to sites, and reviewing comprehensive Trip Reports.
Coordinate and track intricate purchase requests for a wide variety of equipment, material, and services to support mission objectives, ensuring meticulous customer approval and following through on procurement processes via direct purchase or using CACI-established systems/processes to complete purchase orders.
Mentor and provide advanced guidance to junior project coordinators and team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
Develop and implement advanced project management strategies and methodologies to ensure project success.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree in Science, Business Marketing, Business Administration, International Relations, Project/Technology Management, or a related discipline.
5+ years of experience in planning, coordinating, and managing complex projects that provide mission capability to the government or a combination of relevant skills, education, and experience.
Proven experience in stakeholder/customer management and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
In-depth knowledge and mastery of Knowledge Management functions through SharePoint, TEAMs, and/or similar collaboration tools.
Advanced proficiency in developing comprehensive reports and briefings to support management decision-making using Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
TOP SECRET Clearance with SCI eligibility.

Desired

Exceptional communication and engagement skills with senior members of government, industry, and academia.
Extensive experience with CACI internal processes, tools, and procedures.
Familiarity with government contracting and procurement processes.

What You Can Expect

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families.
